meta.title: Toolchain
meta.description: Adds a Toolchain page to Settings between Models and Plugins. Installed npm/pip dependencies are listed with a Delete button per row, above a one-tap install grid of common packages so nothing has to be typed. All 13 folders of the dependency root are listed with their sizes: the four regenerable ones can be emptied, the rest are marked protected. Toolchain versions and the last command's output are shown too.
